agentGuide: Base path /1. Me and my boards: GET /1/members/me?fields=username,fullName, GET /1/members/me/boards?fields=name,url,closed. A board: GET /1/boards/<id>?lists=open&cards=open (or GET /1/boards/<id>/lists, GET /1/boards/<id>/cards). A list's cards: GET /1/lists/<id>/cards?fields=name,desc,due,labels,idMembers,shortUrl. Add a card: POST /1/cards {"idList": "...", "name": "...", "desc": "...", "due": "2026-10-02T10:00:00Z"}; move: PUT /1/cards/<id> {"idList": "..."}; done: PUT /1/cards/<id> {"dueComplete": true}; comment: POST /1/cards/<id>/actions/comments {"text": "..."}. Checklists: GET /1/cards/<id>/checklists; labels: GET /1/boards/<id>/labels. Search: GET /1/search?query=<words>&modelTypes=cards&cards_limit=10. Archive a card: PUT /1/cards/<id> {"closed": true}. The key and the token are set by Allkin.
